headline: The AI Industry's 'Doomer Turn': Frontier Labs Debate Slowing the Pace
summary: MIT Technology Review reports that leading AI executives and safety researchers are increasingly questioning the breakneck speed of frontier model development. Sparked by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call to 'pace the frontier,' industry leaders are openly debating whether catastrophic safety, biosecurity, and national security risks warrant a more measured trajectory.
whyItMatters: A strategic pivot by frontier lab leadership could accelerate international AI safety standards and alter the timeline for next-generation frontier deployments.
